Accel Atoms is Accel’s pre-seed and seed platform for early founders building for the next decade. Designed for ambitious founders, we offer capital, mentorship, and company-building support from Accel’s global network of investors and operators. Since launch, we’ve supported dozens of Indian & Indian diaspora founders, in categories spanning developer infrastructure to consumer, Industry 5.0 and AI. What are the different cohorts I can apply for? Accel Atoms is accepting applications for Atoms AI & Atoms X Cohorts. What is Accel Atoms AI? Accel Atoms AI is a pre-seed program for ambitious early-stage founders building across the AI stack. It is designed to support founders with capital, mentorship, and access to the broader Accel Atoms network as they accelerate their product and company-building journey. What is Atoms X?
